errors.SCALE_NOT_CONFIGURED: No scale is set up on this computer.
errors.SCALE_DRIVER_UNAVAILABLE: This computer cannot read scales. Type the weight.
errors.SCALE_DISCONNECTED: The scale was not found. Check the cable or type the weight.
errors.SCALE_BUSY: Another app is using the scale. Close it and try again.
errors.SCALE_NO_RESPONSE: The scale did not answer. Try again or type the weight.
errors.SCALE_UNSTABLE: The weight is not settling. Wait until the item is still.
errors.SCALE_OVERLOAD: The item is over the scale's capacity.
errors.SCALE_NEGATIVE: The scale shows a negative weight. Remove the item and zero it.
errors.SCALE_EMPTY: Put the item on the scale.
errors.SCALE_UNSUPPORTED_UNIT: The scale weighs in pounds. Set it to kilograms.
errors.failed: Could not read the scale. Type the weight.

settings.title: This computer's scale
settings.noPorts: No serial ports found. Connect the scale and refresh the list.
settings.unavailable: This computer cannot read serial scales. Weights are typed at the till.
settings.saveFailed: Could not save the scale. Refresh the ports and try again.
settings.loadFailed: Could not load the scale settings. Refresh the ports and try again.
